## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which phase or requirement is addressed.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist
- [ ] Pure JavaScript ES6+ & JSX (Strictly NO TypeScript)
- [ ] Structure validation passes (`node scripts/validate-structure.js`)
- [ ] Database migrations tested and non-destructive
- [ ] Tests executed and passing
